title: Ultrastructural Analysis of Kidneys Using Transmission Electron Microscopy
author: Kai Song
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.imzcc76

steps.title: Fix Kidneys
steps.instruction: Fix kidneys in Karnovsky’s fixative for 2 hours at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Karnovsky’s fixative containing 2% paraformaldehyde and 2.5% glutaraldehyde in 0.1% cacodylate buffer (pH 7.2).

steps.title: Post-fix and Mordant Samples
steps.instruction: Perform postfixation and mordanting using cacodylate buffer.

substeps.instruction: Post-fix with 1% osmium tetraoxide in cacodylate buffer for 90 min at 4˚C.
Mordant with 1% tannic acid in cacodylate buffer.

steps.title: Contrast and Image Sections
steps.instruction: Contrast ultrathin sections and examine them via transmission electron microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Contrast sections with uranyl acetate and lead citrate.
Examine samples using a Hitachi H-7600 transmission electron microscope.
